basic_details.job_title: SMC Honorary Super Speciality Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 25 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Surat Municipal Corporation (સુરત મહાનગરપાલિકા) is filling 25 honorary super speciality consultant posts in 15 specialities at the SMIMER hospitals it runs. The posts are filled up to 31 March 2027, and a waiting list will also be prepared. Applications in the prescribed form must be submitted during office hours at Fifth Floor, Recruitment Department, New Annexe Building, Tapipura, Surat, between 16 November 2026 and 30 November 2026. Applications have not opened yet as of 12 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: SMC Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit, the application fee or the selection process.

rows.details: Honorary Super Speciality Consultant in 15 specialities
Honorarium of Rs. 4000/- per month for doctors with a graduate degree and Rs. 6000/- per month for doctors with a postgraduate degree
DM/DNB or M.Ch in the concerned speciality; separate rules for Retina Surgeon and Interventional Radiologist
SMIMER hospitals run by Surat Municipal Corporation, Surat
Prescribed form submitted at the Recruitment Department office, Surat, during office hours

content_sections.heading: About SMC
content_sections.text: Surat Municipal Corporation is the municipal body of Surat, Gujarat, with its office at Shree Tapi Bhavan, Gordhandas Chokhawala Marg, Tapipura, Surat. The corporation runs the SMIMER hospitals, and these honorary super speciality consultant posts are for those hospitals. The recruitment follows the terms and conditions in resolution no. 915/2005 dated 14/10/2005 and the General Board resolution no. 630/2023 dated 27/10/2023.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications go to the Recruitment Department of Surat Municipal Corporation at this address: Fifth Floor, Recruitment Department, New Annexe Building, Tapipura, Surat. The notice says applications are invited at this office during office hours from 16/11/2026 to 30/11/2026. It does not mention sending applications by post or email. Get the application format from the Surat Municipal Corporation website ( www.suratmunicipal.gov.in ). The same form, titled "Application for the Honorary Post of ...", is printed on pages 3 and 4 of the notice. Write the name of the post you are applying for in the title line of the form. Fill the form in block letters with a black ball point pen only, as the form instructs. Give your name, correspondence address with PIN code, residence phone with STD code, mobile number, email ID, sex, date of birth, category, PAN number, mother tongue and other languages known. Fill in your educational qualifications (institute or university, examination, passing month and year, main subject, percentage and number of attempts) and your experience (institution, dates, designation and nature of work, salary drawn, years and months). Attach attested copies of the documents listed under Enclosures, and sign the declaration with place and date. Submit the application at the Recruitment Department, Fifth Floor, New Annexe Building, Tapipura, Surat, during office hours between 16 November 2026 and 30 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Surat Municipal Corporation has listed 25 honorary posts across six departments. The same honorarium applies to all posts: Rs. 4000/- per month for doctors with a graduate degree and Rs. 6000/- per month for doctors with a postgraduate degree, with recruitment up to 31/03/2027. The notice prints the number for each post but no overall total. The figure of 25 is the sum of the post-wise numbers. The notice gives the following qualification for each post: Gastroenterology: DM/DNB-Gastro Endocrinology: DM/DNB-Endocrino Neurology: DM/DNB-Neuro Haematology: DM/DNB-Heamato Nephrology: DM/DNB-Nephro Paediatric Surgery: M.Ch-Paediatric Surgery Plastic Surgery: M.Ch-Plastic Surgery Urology: M.Ch-Urology Cardio-Thoracic Surgery: M.Ch-Cardio-Thoracic Surgery Gastroenterologist: M.Ch, or DNB-Surgical Gastroenterologist and Liver Transplantation Ortho (Joint Replacement): M.Ch-Ortho Retina Surgeon: Fellow of National Board In Retinal Speciality (FNB) after MS Ophthalmology, or two years fellowship in retina from reputed institute after MS ophthalmology Interventional Radiologist: (A) Assistant Professor (Interventional Radiologist) Post M.D. (Radiologist), or DNB Radiology with atleast work in Interventional for two years; or (B) M.D. (Radiologist) with two years of fellowship in Interventional Radiology Neonatology: DM/DNB- Neonet Paediatric Cardiologists: DM/DNB Fellowship in Pediatric Cardiology For any of these posts that requires a registration certificate, the candidate must attach a copy of the registration certificate of the Gujarat Council. The notice makes this compulsory. The notice calls the pay a "honorary remuneration" (માનદ વેતન), following General Board resolution no. 630/2023 dated 27/10/2023. It is Rs. 4000/- per month for doctors with a graduate degree and Rs. 6000/- per month for doctors with a postgraduate degree. The notice does not mention any allowance in addition to this amount. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The notice requires attested copies of these documents with the application: School leaving certificate as proof of age Marksheet and certificate for educational qualification, and the degree certificate Experience certificate Proof of residence Contact number (mobile / phone number) EPIC card, Aadhaar card and PAN card Copy of the Gujarat Council registration certificate, for posts that require registration The application form also has a checklist of documents to tick: Birth Certificate; School leaving Certificate; Diploma, Graduation and Post Graduation mark sheets and certificates; Caste Certificate; Experience Certificate on letter pad only; CCC, CCC+ or any other certificate related to Computer Education; Attempt Certificate if any; PAN Card; Aadhaar Card; and other information, if any. The form asks for attested copies of relevant documents only.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The posts are honorary and are filled up to 31 March 2027. Surat Municipal Corporation will also prepare a waiting list from these applications. The posts are subject to the terms and conditions in resolution no. 915/2005 dated 14/10/2005. Only the prescribed form is accepted. Fill it in block letters with a black ball point pen only. Under the declaration in the form, incorrect, fake or manipulated information or proof means the candidature is disqualified, and the candidate is liable to be dismissed if appointed. The notice is signed by the Deputy Municipal Commissioner (D), Surat Municipal Corporation.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are in SMC Recruitment 2026 for super speciality consultants?
faq.answer: There are 25 honorary super speciality consultant posts in 15 specialities at the SMIMER hospitals of Surat Municipal Corporation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted during office hours from 16 November 2026 to 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: Most posts need a DM/DNB or M.Ch in the concerned speciality, for example DM/DNB-Neuro for Neurology and M.Ch-Urology for Urology. Retina Surgeon and Interventional Radiologist have their own fellowship-based or M.D./DNB-based qualifications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for SMC honorary consultants?
faq.answer: The honorarium is Rs. 4000/- per month for doctors with a graduate degree and Rs. 6000/- per month for doctors with a postgraduate degree.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed form from the Surat Municipal Corporation website and submit it with attested document copies at Fifth Floor, Recruitment Department, New Annexe Building, Tapipura, Surat, during office hours.

faq.question: Q6. Where can I get the application form?
faq.answer: The application format is available on the Surat Municipal Corporation website, and the same form is printed on pages 3 and 4 of the notice.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are honorary and are filled up to 31 March 2027, and a waiting list will also be prepared.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Gujarat Council registration certificate needed?
faq.answer: Yes, for posts that require a registration certificate, a copy of the Gujarat Council registration certificate must be attached to the application.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents must be attached?
faq.answer: Attested copies of the school leaving certificate, marksheets and degree certificate, experience certificate, proof of residence, contact number, and the EPIC card, Aadhaar card and PAN card.
